name: Hollow Warden

source.note: Entered from reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within, which reworked the 2025 Unearthed Arcana version; the published numbers for Wrath of the Wild (AC bonus, aura save) are not confirmed. Compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Rangers who draw on ancient, hungry terrors of the wild places and become monstrous guardians themselves.

feature.name: Hollow Warden Spells
feature.summary: Wrathful Smite always prepared; more at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17.
feature.text: When you reach a Ranger level shown, you always have these spells prepared: Wrathful Smite (3); Alter Self (5); Phantom Steed (9); Dominate Beast (13); Steel Wind Strike (17).

feature.name: Wrath of the Wild
feature.summary: Bonus Action, a Favored Enemy use: transform for 1 minute: +AC, a 10-foot aura that frightens foes, and an Opportunity Attack when a foe hurts you or an ally beside you.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can expend one use of your Favored Enemy feature to transform for 1 minute (you can end it early, no action required). Rotten bark, bristles or bloody antlers break out on you. While transformed: Ancient Armor: you gain a bonus to AC equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Unnerving Aura: when an enemy starts its turn within 10 feet of you, it makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Retribution: when a creature within your reach damages you or an ally within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against it.

feature.name: Hungering Might
feature.summary: +Wisdom modifier to Constitution saves; while transformed and Bloodied, a hit heals 1d10 + Wisdom modifier once per turn.
feature.text: You gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). In addition, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll while transformed by Wrath of the Wild and Bloodied, you regain 1d10 plus your Wisdom modifier Hit Points.

feature.name: Rot and Violence
feature.summary: While transformed, creatures your aura frightens can't regain Hit Points or take Reactions, and your weapon hits can add Sap or Slow to their own mastery.
feature.text: While transformed by Wrath of the Wild: a creature Frightened by your Unnerving Aura can't regain Hit Points or take Reactions; and when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can apply the Sap or Slow mastery property in addition to the weapon's own mastery property.

feature.name: Ancient Endurance
feature.summary: Immune to Exhaustion; +Wisdom modifier damage against Frightened creatures; once per Long Rest (or a level 4+ slot) dropping to 0 while transformed leaves you at 30 Hit Points.
feature.text: Timeless: you have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition. Dread Hunter: while transformed, your attacks deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier to Frightened creatures. Persistent Hunt: if you drop to 0 Hit Points while transformed and don't die outright, your Hit Points become 30 instead; once you do this you can't again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a spell slot of level 4 or higher (no action) to do so.
